reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows recalled model B0726Y, so the model is confirmed.
The date code 8/21 is within the recalled range (August 2021 or earlier).
Fred Meyer is a listed retailer and the 2023-09-03 purchase date is inside the sale window. No receipt is required.
No other claims share a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
The destruction photo does not show the instructed destruction. It shows no helmet with straps cut off, and the policy asks for a new photo in this case.
The serial check was skipped because the program has no serial rule, so the serial was not used in the decision.

input.question_for_claimant: Please upload a new photo of your recalled helmet (model B0726Y) with both straps cut off, as the recall instructs, and send it to consumersupport-bell@bellhelmets.com. The photo should clearly show the helmet and the cut straps, and should not be the label photo.
